product_one_liner.value: Typeface is an AI marketing platform for enterprise teams that orchestrates people, agents, and systems to create and run on-brand campaigns at scale.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs visitors to demos and contact sales, has no pricing navigation link, and no readable public pricing page was found at /pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in customer testimonials on the homepage.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn shows 281 associated employee profiles, and Indexed lists 201–500 employees; LinkedIn’s separate company-size label is 51–200.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains marketing guidance and product announcements; two qualifying engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built were not found.

public_docs.notes: Public developer portal with guides, a quickstart, recipes, and API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open Senior ML Engineer posting in Palo Alto.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4; Google Vertex AI; Microsoft Azure AI; Stability.ai Stable Diffusion.
model_provider.notes: These models and platforms are explicitly named on Typeface’s platform page.

last_funding.notes: Latest reported round according to Indexed. Records disagree: PitchBook and CB Insights instead list an undisclosed September 2025 VC round. No company announcement confirming the October round was located.

raised_18mo.notes: Funding databases report rounds in September or October 2025, but no dated announcement or filing meeting this question’s evidence requirement was located.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 22, 2026, Typeface announced the next generation of its Orchestration Engine, including Arc Graph, Arc Fabric, and Arc Loop.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A VP, Strategy & Operations profile lists a September 2026 start at Typeface.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Public integration signal, not confirmation that Typeface uses Salesforce as its own internal CRM.
